fields.Name: Top 10 Most Engaged Members
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: Who are our top 10 most engaged members based on their event attendance, course enrollments, and chapter participation? Show this as a ranked table with their engagement metrics. I want to be able to click on any member to open their profile. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Top 10 Most Engaged Members Leaderboard ranks your top federation members using a composite engagement score calculated from event attendance, course completions, and committee participation. It includes summary benchmark KPI cards, quick segment and region filters, and one-click navigation directly to any member's full profile.
